summary: Full backend + frontend testing of RecRoute39 ATS. 29/29 pytest backend tests pass covering auth, dashboard, candidate CRUD, duplicate phone, resume upload/download, HR updates timeline, status changes, send-for-approval, management decision, approvals queue, HR monitoring RBAC, jobs RBAC, activity log. Frontend flows verified end-to-end: HR login -> add candidate (with duplicate phone alert) -> open profile -> HR update -> status change -> resume upload/view -> send for approval; Management login -> Approvals queue -> Approve (works both from queue button and from profile). Role-based nav visibility correct (HR sees Dashboard/Candidates/Jobs/Activity; Management sees Approvals + HR Monitoring; HR does not see Approvals or Monitoring). Toasts render (Candidate Added Successfully, Approval Sent to Management).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 782 lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, candidates, jobs, approvals) for maintainability.
CORS_ORIGINS env var is defined ('*') but unused; ALLOWED_ORIGINS is hardcoded to FRONTEND_URL + localhost. Either wire the env var or drop it to avoid confusion.
Resume view/download link builds URL as `${RESUME_URL(id)}?auth=` with empty token; relies on httpOnly cookie. Works but the empty `?auth=` param is dead code that could mislead future devs.

hr_monitoring 'contacted/interviewed/shortlisted' uses status_history match, which counts a candidate even if they later moved to a different status - intended per append-only design, but worth documenting.
AddCandidateModal debounce for duplicate check triggers on every keystroke (no debounce). Fine at low volume but could be debounced.
